title: Aldous' spectral gap phenomena in stochastic exchange models
summary: We consider a broad class of exchange dynamics with arbitrary weighted graph or hypergraph update structures, which includes the Kipnis--Marchioro--Presutti (KMP) model and the energies of Kac's walk on the sphere. These are conservative continuous-spin systems whose reversible measures are Dirichlet distributions. We prove that their spectral gap is always attained by a polynomial of degree at most two in the energy variables.
